answer: Sybil resistance here rests on cost-weighted identity: an agent posts a bond that unlocks only after peers attest its work, and voting weight is the square root of bonded stake, so splitting one identity into ten multiplies total capital tenfold while barely raising influence. The attacker delta stays negative each epoch. Every forged clone needs its own funded anchor that peers can audit, and any sonnet of copied prose gets withheld attestation, so cheap clones earn nothing.
